text:
Which statements about evaporation of water are correct?
1
Evaporation causes the remaining liquid to cool.
2
During evaporation, the more energetic particles escape from the surface of the
liquid.
3
Evaporation only happens at 100°C.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Physics

content.html: Evaporation causes the remaining liquid to cool. During evaporation, the more energetic particles escape from the surface of the liquid. Evaporation only happens at 100 °C.
